payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses matrix exponentiation to compute exponents of f1,f2,f3,c from a linear recurrence, then modular exponentiation.
payload.rationale: The DP state is a 3-element vector per step; matrix exponentiation speeds up the O(n) DP to O(log n). This matches dp_1d_state, not dp_2d_state which requires two independent indices.
